where_the_evidence_runs_out: The entity was chosen by a name match. 9 other label-matching clusters were not merged with it, because no publisher asserts they are the same.
Counterparties were truncated to the most-connected 10 at hop 1 and 10 at hop 2 (of 196 and 66 seen).
Nothing beyond two hops was examined, and classifications, places, lists and programmes were not expanded. For a longer chain use "wm serve" /graph/paths or "python3 -m worldmodel graph-paths".

Events are found here only where the publisher anchors the event on this ID as its subject. Events that name the entity only among their participants (storm events, disaster declarations, AIS reports) are not reachable from an entity ID in this index.
No asserted SEC filer identity: neither sec_issuer_reference nor GLEIF's SEC registration authority (RA000665) links this LEI to a CIK.

Outside this index scope entirely: companies_house_uk (the UK company register and persons with significant control); gdelt_events (news-derived event records); osm_topology (the OpenStreetMap routing graph); osm_us_midwest (OpenStreetMap US Midwest extract); osm_us_northeast (OpenStreetMap US Northeast extract); osm_us_south (OpenStreetMap US South extract); sec_13f_history (the full quarterly 13F holding history (only the sec_ownership_datasets filings are here)); usaspending (federal contract transactions); usaspending_assistance (federal assistance transactions).
what_this_does_not_establish: A dossier is an inventory of published claims about the IDs in one asserted cluster. It is not a profile anyone has verified, and a claim's presence is not evidence that it is true or current.
An edge states only its predicate, as published by its dataset. Two entities two hops apart are not related in any stated way; a shared counterparty is not a relationship.

Not a sanctions determination. A listing applies to the named party on the named list at the list version pinned here; group membership does not transfer it, and OpenSanctions also carries ownership, debarment and politically-exposed-person records that are not designations.
GLEIF Level 2 records accounting consolidation, not control or beneficial ownership.
Absence of an edge, observation or event here is absence of published evidence in this index scope, not absence in the world. The index pins one version of each input dataset.
Nothing is merged: records are the publishers' own claims, copied verbatim, and contradictory claims stay side by side.

Identity is asserted only (published same_as links, shared unique identifiers, published crosswalk fields). Entities whose names merely look alike are never joined; where a product had to use a name, it says INFERRED, not asserted.
Rights and use-policy metadata are an inventory, not a legal determination, and nothing here authorises republishing the acquired data.
